This document explains retrieval, the chronicle and the review queue in one place. 사용 안내서입니다.

The chronicle reads the bitemporal node and edge versions plus the conversation messages for that day.
키워드 0.35, 벡터 0.40, 그래프 0.25 가중치로 융합합니다. The weights are configurable per query class.
We decided the hybrid ranking keeps alpha fusion: the lexical channel scores one over rank and the vector channel is the max normalized score. Retrieval owns the decision.
